summary: A browser inspection found an active-looking Sylvania Facebook Marketplace offer at $115 per 24-foot length. Five full usable 24-foot lengths fit the existing 36-blank tube cut list, giving $575 in candidate goods versus the $930.90 retail reference. Seller claims, material condition/grade/wall and pickup cost are unverified, so this is not a delivered quotation or an adopted CAD substitution.
observation_method: Parent agent inspected the live Facebook Marketplace page through the normal browser after dismissing a login overlay. Public search/fetch had not returned usable listings. No seller contact or order.
search_location: Alto, GA, within 40 miles selected; Marketplace also surfaced wider-area results. Do not infer every returned listing is within that radius.

listings.title: Square Steel Tubing 2x2x24ft x 1/8 inch walls
listings.spec: Seller advertises 2 × 2 inch square steel tubing, 24 ft length, 1/8 inch walls; description says 28 pieces remain. Page says In stock, Condition New, Door pickup. Description calls the tube weathered with a brown rusted surface and green interior coating.
listings.qualification: Candidate only. Live page and price observed, but inventory, grade, actual wall, straightness, coating and usable length are seller claims requiring confirmation/inspection. Sylvania is outside the requested local search area. Five usable 24 ft bars fit the existing blank lengths; goods $575 before tax/pickup. No material substitution or budget saving adopted.
listings.availability_status: Page displayed In stock; seller stock not confirmed

listings.title: 2x2 square steel tubing $6 Each
listings.spec: Live page says In stock, Condition Used - Like New. Description says 5 tube minimum, square tubing 2x2x31.5, $6 each. Wall and grade are not stated.
listings.qualification: Short-stock lead only. At 31.5 inches (800.1 mm), these cannot supply the 949.2–1450 mm chassis blanks. No splices assumed. Potentially usable for 648.8 mm members/accessories only after wall, grade, condition and dimensions are confirmed; a mixed-stock cutting plan would be required. Not a replacement for the full tube lot.

listings.title: Square Tubing
listings.price_display: $110 per 20 ft piece; $70 for one 13 ft piece ($1 headline is a placeholder)
listings.spec: Live page says listed four weeks ago, Used - Fair. Description: two 2 × 2 inch, quarter-inch-wall, 20 ft pieces at $110 each; one 2 × 2 inch, quarter-inch-wall, 13 ft piece at $70.
listings.qualification: Not adopted. Advertised 0.250 inch wall is much thicker than the modeled 0.120 inch wall and would increase weight; fit and load effects require review. Listed quantity is insufficient for the full frame lot. Headline $1 is not the actual stock price. Inventory and condition unconfirmed with seller.

listings.title: Steel tubing — 2 × 4 inch, quarter-inch wall
listings.spec: Description advertises 2 × 4 inch tubing with quarter-inch wall, 20 ft length; two pieces left.
listings.qualification: Rejected for current chassis: wrong cross-section and wall. Headline $20 is a per-foot rate, not a 20-foot-bar price. Seller inventory unconfirmed.
